title: RV & Boat Storage Space Class Specifications and Unit Acceptance Standards
content:
Each community's fenced storage yard rents RV & Boat Storage spaces in six classes. A class accepts a unit only when the unit's type is one the class lists and the unit falls within the class's length limit and, where one is set, its height limit. The overall length is measured including the tongue and bumper attachments.

## Specification sheet

| Space class | Unit types accepted | Longest unit accepted (ft, incl. tongue and bumper attachments) | Tallest unit accepted (ft) | Overhead clearance of the space (ft) | Renter supplies own lock for the unit door |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open Compact Storage Space | boat, trailer, truck camper | 20 | no height limit set | not applicable (open space) | no |
| Open Standard Storage Space | RV, boat, trailer | 30 | no height limit set | not applicable (open space) | no |
| Open Large Storage Space | RV, boat, trailer | 40 | no height limit set | not applicable (open space) | no |
| Covered Standard Storage Space | RV, boat, trailer | 30 | 13.5 | 14 (14.0) | no |
| Covered Large Storage Space | RV, boat, trailer | 45 | 13.5 | 14 (14.0) | no |
| Enclosed Storage Unit | RV, boat, trailer | 40 | 13.5 | 14 (14.0) | yes |

## Standards common to every class

| Standard | Every RV & Boat Storage class |
|---|---|
| Rented only to holders of an active Hearthstone site lease in the same community | yes |
| Current insurance on the stored unit must be on file | yes |
| The stored unit must carry current registration | yes |
| The stored unit must be operable or road-towable | yes |
| The space may be sublet or used for a unit that does not belong to the household | no |

## Points of judgement

- **Type.** The Open Compact Storage Space is the only class that lists a truck camper, and it does not list an RV. Every other class lists RVs, boats and trailers.
- **Length.** The limit is a longest-accepted figure: a unit whose overall length equals the class limit is within it, and a unit one foot longer is not. A hypothetical 30-foot trailer is within the Open Standard Storage Space and the Covered Standard Storage Space; a hypothetical 31-foot trailer is within neither, but is within the Open Large Storage Space, the Covered Large Storage Space and the Enclosed Storage Unit.
- **Height.** Only the covered classes and the Enclosed Storage Unit set a height limit (13.5 feet). A hypothetical boat on its trailer standing 13.5 feet tall is within that limit; one standing 14 feet tall is not, even though the space's overhead clearance is 14 feet. The open classes have no overhead clearance figure because they are open.
- **Lock.** At the Enclosed Storage Unit the renter supplies the lock for the unit door; no other class requires one.
